entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press one.
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, could I have your order number?

Thank you. I see the order here. It was delivered on December 15th. Now, to make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It works just fine, it's really a matter of preference. I thought I'd use it more than I have. It's just sitting in the box, so I was hoping to return it.

I understand. Okay, looking at the delivery date, it's been about 23 days. I have to be upfront, our return policy for wearable tech can be quite strict. For reasons of hygiene and public sanitation, we usually can't accept returns on opened items after 20 days. At this point, it would be too late.

I see. I can appreciate the hygiene concern, but it was barely handled. Since a full refund isn't possible, is there any chance for a partial store credit? I'm happy to keep doing business with VeloFit, but I just have no use for this specific item. I thought the online policy mentioned a longer window.

You know what, you're right to ask. You mentioned the online policy, and I know some things have recently changed for our newer product lines. Let me put you on a brief hold while I pull up the specific documentation for the Cadence Sensor. It's important we get this right. One moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've double-checked, and I owe you an apology. I was referencing the new, stricter policy for our heart-rate monitors. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor, the one you purchased, actually falls under our standard 90-day return policy. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh! That's fantastic news. Thank you so much for checking that for me, Charlie.

Of course, and I'm glad you brought it up. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak. Please package the sensor in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be processed.
That's perfect. That's exactly what I was hoping for. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
